---
name: Feature proposal
about: Propose a focused capability or contract change
title: "[Proposal]: "
labels: proposal
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the user problem without prescribing an implementation.

## Proposed outcome

What observable behavior would solve it? What is explicitly out of scope?

## Authority, privacy, and evidence impact

Explain changes to permissions, decision rights, data classes, external
effects, telemetry, artifacts, verification, or evidence claims.

## Portability and compatibility

Which packages, public contracts, runtimes, or adapters are affected? Could the
proposal remain provider- and platform-neutral?

## Alternatives

List practical alternatives and why they are insufficient.

## Decision process

Indicate whether this requires an RFC or ADR under GOVERNANCE.md. Do not include
private operational data, market claims, credentials, or customer content.
